summary.text: Stephen Stanley is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 113 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Rhetta Andrews Bowers.
A real estate professional, he served on the Garland City Council from 2013 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Stanley was born in Dallas, Texas, graduated from South Garland High School, and earned an associate degree from Richland Community College in 1988.
His career experience is in real estate, and in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey he said he has been licensed and practicing real estate for more than 40 years in the North Texas area.
In that survey he said he was elected to the Sachse City Council in 1998 and again in 2001, and later to the Garland City Council in 2013, with re-election in 2015.
Stanley advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.

In his 2024 survey, he said he wants a more directed effort at permanently reducing property taxes, leading to their elimination, and listed over-taxation and school choice among his policy interests.
He also called for election-integrity changes, including restoring neighborhood voting precincts and paper poll books.
